scope: Isolated30-day logical-duty unit/person experiment; canonical safety and first two objective tiers only, not production architecture activation/selection.
objective_scope: All30 logical duties mandatory; coverage then common-call equality. At fixed coverage common target terms cancel. Unit contributions are descriptive, not a new objective. Weekend/night/history/preferences tiers not compared.
budget_scope: Same per-method monotonic wall allowance including model construction, all solver calls and canonical validation; common fixture/candidate preprocessing reported separately. Blocking stages may overrun; report actual overrun, not a hard-cancel guarantee.
template_scope: Initial alternating unit layout is prescribed for this experiment, not generated by the current production template.

memory.scope: Sampled whole Python process RSS including native CP-SAT, shared fixture and prior retained allocations; not continuous peaks or isolated method memory.
